body: I'm drawn to the shimmering line of blue shells, each one as intricate as an underwater painting. Their smooth, polished surfaces catch the light from the water's edge, casting dancing shadows across my vision. I hesitate at first, afraid of stepping too close for fear of disturbing their delicate balance in the currents below. Yet curiosity wins out over caution, and I take a tentative step forward.
